outer_split.status: NEW Phase 2B experimental design decision - NOT part of the original frozen specification
outer_split.ordering_note: Python default string sort on basename, e.g. 'area1' < 'area10' < 'area11' < ... < 'area17' < 'area2' - lexicographic, not numeric.
outer_split.randomization: none - no shuffle, no seed, purely positional after lexicographic sort

target_probe.status: NEW Phase 2B experimental design decision - NOT part of the original frozen specification
target_probe.rule: first 5 files (by lexicographic order) of the target_train partition
target_probe.rationale: The original freeze (DSSA_PROJECT_FREEZE.md Sec O-I) specifies target-probe as 'roughly 10-20% of the total target pool' (33 files), not a unique integer. 10% of 33 = 3.3, 20% of 33 = 6.6. Five files is approximately 15.15% of the 33-file total target pool, near the midpoint of the stated range. This integer (5) was not specified by the original freeze and is recorded here as a new, explicit decision.
